newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares rise on back of SKB jump.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares rise on back of SKB jump.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index rose for the sixth day on Thursday, pushed up by an almost six percent jump in bank SKB.

"Most prices are seen as low at the moment, as is the case with SKB, which was also pushed up by today's decision to split its shares. I think SKB could easily rise to up to 50,000 tolars," one trader said.
* The SBI index rose 0.77 percent or 9.45 points to 1,237.6.
* Bank SKB was the top gainer and had the highest turnover, jumping 5.98 percent to 45,900 tolars on volume 494 shares for total turnover of 22.5 million.
* Dolenjska bank's preferred share led decliners, falling 3.20 percent to 12,100 tolars on volume of 86 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
